name: 15478-topksample-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90), one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine (guidellm's `vllm_python` backend).
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16; read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 512, warmup 25% by completed requests, bound 4096 requests, 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no tools: prompt exactly 128 tokens, output exactly 256 (ignore_eos), sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 / top_k 20 on every request, `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant generating 256-token replies from short prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine 733e7c9e95f5 (v0.8.2-36-g733e7c9e95). Nothing here is tuned and there is no tuned.yaml.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# This engine's own V1 defaults, written out so a later default cannot drift them.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048

# Deliberately off; this engine's V1 default is on.
enable-prefix-caching: false
